dedupe_keys.name: agrometinfo agroclimatic indicators for crops in metropolitan france inrae meteo france

description: A web service of daily agroclimatic indicators for crops across mainland France. The AgroMetInfo home page says it offers near real-time indicators of agroclimatic conditions for crops, starting with key periods for winter crops, computed from Météo-France SAFRAN reanalysis on the 8 km grid and grouped by small agricultural region, recalculated daily and after monthly and annual updates; version 2.0.19 went online on 9 September 2026. The INRAE news article says the tool, earlier named VAC, covers more than 8,000 points with 25 indicators of climate and water balance and runs the STICS crop model with a fixed protocol to give a climatic yield. It is free to use online with an interactive map; site texts are under the etalab-2.0 licence and the code is open. Coverage is metropolitan France. Caveats: yields are theoretical, climate-only values. For simulation it tracks drought and heat stress on crops in season. A related catalogue record is the STICS soil-crop model.
